reason: CPU exhaustion in the Avro decoder. No fixed version of github.com/hamba/avro/v2 is known (the OSV record's affected range has an "introduced": "0" event and no "fixed" event); only the fork github.com/iskorotkov/avro/v2 carries a fix, starting at 2.33.0. hamba/avro/v2 arrives indirectly, through github.com/apache/pulsar-client-go v0.21.0's schema support, not as a direct dependency of this module.
exposure: Package-level finding: the OSV record lists no affected symbols. ego's pulsar publisher only produces protobuf-encoded payloads; it does not use Pulsar Avro schemas and does not consume or decode messages. The vulnerable decoder is reachable only through pulsar-client-go's schema support, which this publisher never exercises. This is a temporarily accepted risk, not a claim that the package is safe against untrusted input in general.
removal: Remove this entry when github.com/hamba/avro/v2 ships a fixed version (bump the dependency) or when github.com/apache/pulsar-client-go stops depending on it. The gate fails this entry as stale on its own once GO-2026-5046 no longer appears as a called finding for publisher/pulsar, forcing the removal.
